commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Adrian Liso (Getafe) has weakened his team by being sent-off early, following two yellow cards and the inevitable red.
90+5' That was really pointless. Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) was being offensive and couldn't control himself. He gave Alejandro Ruiz no choice but to send him off.
90+4' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) gets booked.
90+4' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+3' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+2' Diego Rico (Getafe) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
90+1' Substitution. Martin Satriano makes his way off the pitch and Abdel Abqar (Getafe) comes on as his replacement.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

90' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, David Soria makes a great save to stop his effort.
89' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
87' Here's the change. Aurelien Tchouameni leaves the pitch and Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
85' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
85' The attendance for today's match is 65104.
84' Martin Satriano (Getafe) is yellow-carded.
80' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
79' Adrian Liso (Getafe) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
78' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
75' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

74' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Real Madrid.
71' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
69' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Luis Vazquez is replaced by Mario Martin (Getafe).
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Arda Guler cannot continue after picking up an injury.
68' Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
66' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
64' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Diego Rico (Getafe) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
64' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
59' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Rodrygo (Real Madrid). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

59' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.
59' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
58' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
58' Substitution. Kiko Femenia will be replaced by Adrian Liso (Getafe).
55' It is time for a substitution. Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) is on for Trent Alexander-Arnold.
55' Here is a change. David Alaba is going off and Alvaro Arbeloa gives the last tactical orders to Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid).
55' A substitution has been made. Thiago Pitarch is replaced by Rodrygo (Real Madrid).
55' Thiago Pitarch (Real Madrid) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
51' Thiago Pitarch (Real Madrid) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but David Soria is equal to it and makes an easy save.
50' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' Alejandro Ruiz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+5' Chance! Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
45+4' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45+3' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
45+2' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.

42' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by David Soria, who pulls off a comfortable save!

41' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Real Madrid are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
39' 0 - 1 What a hit! Martin Satriano (Getafe) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the top right corner. 0:1.
36' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
36' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Real Madrid will take a corner kick.
35' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Ruiz had an easy-decision to make.
28' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
24' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
24' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. David Soria makes a great save to deny his effort directed under the crossbar.
20' Luis Milla (Getafe) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch.
20' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
19' A pass by Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
17' The ball is cleared after Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
14' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
14' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Arda Guler (Real Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
14' Excellent touch by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.

13' He should have scored! Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and David Soria makes an easy save.
11' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

11' Diego Rico (Getafe) strikes a promising volley towards goal, but one of the defenders is quick enough to step in and make a crucial block. The ball is out of play and Getafe manage to earn a corner.
10' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
8' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

7' So close! Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.
6' Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe). Another situation results in a direct free kick for Real Madrid.
4' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul. Real Madrid win a free kick.
3' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
2' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the right post.
